# Cash+ Credit Card | 1% Cashback Card - HSBC UAE

Apply now

#

Cash+ Credit Card

The credit card that rewards you when you shop.

##
Spend on your Cash+ Credit Card for cashback every day

Earn daily cashback on eligible purchases up to your credit card limit, with no minimum spend. Plus, enjoy a range of travel and lifestyle benefits.

To apply, you'll need to earn at least AED 30,000 a month.

Get started

##
Why get a Cash+ Credit Card?

###

Earn daily cashback on all your spends

Earn 1% cashback every day on all your purchases up to your credit card limit, with no minimum spend.

###

10% bonus cashback

Get 10% bonus cashback all year when you meet minimum spends.

###

Annual fee waiver

Pay no annual fee for the first year, and when you spend at least AED 24,000 a year after that[@cashplusannualfeewaiver].

###

Careem Plus

Get a complimentary 12-month Careem Plus subscription. Simply add and use your HSBC credit card on the Careem app.

##
Discover more Cash+ features

###
Enjoy more of the things you love

A range of rewards on shopping, eating out and more, worldwide.

-

Buy 1 Get 1 Free movie tickets every month when you spend at least ⃃10,000 in the calendar month of booking and up to 25% off food and drink at cinemas across the UAE.[@cards-cinema-minimum-spend-generic]

-

Get deals on shopping, travel, dining and more worldwide with home&Away.

-

Get up to 7% back as wallet credits with Booking.com accommodations when you book on your credit card.

-

Get up to 50% off dining bills at over 4,000 restaurants across the UAE with your complimentary Zomato Gold membership. Learn more.

###
Complimentary airport lounge access

Unwind before you fly with access to airport lounges worldwide through the Visa Airport Companion app.

-

Access over 1,000 lounges in more than 300 cities worldwide.

-

Complimentary access for you and 1 guest[@unlimitedairportloungeaccess]. USD 32 for each extra guest, per visit.

-

Make at least 1 international purchase worth USD 1 with your HSBC Visa card 15 days before you travel to enjoy unlimited visits.

-

You'll need the Visa Companion app to access your airport benefits. Download it from Google Play or the App Store today.

##
Your Cash+ card also comes with

-

24-hour concierge

Visa Concierge takes care of the details, from restaurant bookings and bespoke shopping, to travel plans and more. Call 800 0441 3487 from the UAE or +9714 361 1234 / +44 2078 502 829 from outside the UAE.

-

Multi-trip travel insurance

Complimentary cover of up to USD 500,000 for you and your family on all trips up to 90 days, including a certificate of insurance[@visainternational].

-

Extended warranty on your purchases

Automatic extended warranty on purchases you make in full with your card. It doubles the original manufacturer’s warranty for up to 1 year. Offered by Visa International.

-

Save on data roaming

Get 15% off additional data packages, with Airalo. T&Cs apply.

-

YQ Meet & Assist

Save up to 30% on Airport Meet & Assist at over 450 locations worldwide.

-

Digital cards

Add your HSBC UAE cards to your digital wallet for instant contactless purchases. You don't even need to wait for them to be delivered - just access your card details in the HSBC UAE app.

-

Fraud protection

You're covered for fraudulent transactions on your card up to USD 2,500 a claim and up to USD 4,000 a year.[@visainternational]

##
Things to know

###
Who can apply?

You don't need an account with us to apply for a Cash+ Credit Card, but you'll need to:

- earn at least AED 30,000 a month

- be aged between 18 and 65

- live in the UAE

###
Fees and rates

- 44.28% APR fixed[@aproverduepayments] on cash withdrawals and purchases

- AED 0 for the first 12 months. Then AED 1,050 including VAT[@cashplusannualfeewaiver]

#### What you'll need

All proofs of ID, including your:

- passport

- Emirates ID

- residence visa if you're a non-GCC national

Proof you're a UAE resident. Choose one of the following:

- a tenancy agreement or EJARI

- title deeds if you’re a homeowner

- a utility bill no more than 2 months old

All proofs of income, including:

- the last 2 bank statements from the account your salary is paid into, or 2 salary credits into your HSBC account

- a salary certificate from your employer issued in the last month

If you're applying for an additional card, you'll also need to provide the passport and Emirates ID information for the additional cardholder.

Once you've been accepted, we'll also ask for a security cheque in the value of 120% of your credit facility. This doesn't apply for existing Premier or Global Private Banking customers.

#### Additional cardholders

Share your card benefits with your loved ones and enjoy more together with a supplementary credit card.

-

Apply for a supplementary card

#### If you're new to the UAE

If you're new to the UAE, you won't have built up a credit history here yet, which can make getting a new credit card a hassle. But with HSBC, you can use the credit history you've built up elsewhere, making it easier to get a card here in your new home.

At present, you can share your credit history from any of the following countries:

- Australia

- Canada

- Dominican Republic

- India

- Kenya

- Mexico

- Nigeria

- Philippines

- Spain

- Switzerland

- United Kingdom

- United States

To use your international credit history, just apply for your credit card like normal. If you're eligible, we'll ask you during your application if you'd like to share your credit history with us.

-

More about using your international credit history

##
Get started

###
New to HSBC?

Check your eligibility online and get an approval in principle in just 5 minutes.

Once we've approved your application, your card could be with you within 24 hours.

Apply now

###
Already an HSBC customer?

Apply for your card in minutes in the HSBC UAE app. Just open the app, go to 'Products', then select 'Credit cards'.

Apply in app
Apply in app This link will open in same window

### Other ways to apply

Apply via callback

Request a callback and a member of our team will help you to apply for your card.

We'll get back to you during working hours, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 16:30. If you contact us outside these times, we aim to get back to you on the next working day. We may record calls to help improve our service to you.

-

Get a callback

Get a callback This link will open in new window This link will open in a new window

##
Frequently asked questions

### How do I pay my credit card?

You can pay your credit card at an HSBC branch or ATM:

- by cheque

- online with HSBC or another bank

- with mobile or phone banking if you have an account with us

### Are there payment plans available?

Yes, you can pay your credit card using a Flexi instalment or cash instalment plan.

A Flexi instalment plan lets you convert big purchases you make with your credit card into smaller monthly payments. This option offers:

- low interest rates

- no processing or early repayment fees

- the option to spread costs over 3 to 36 months

Apply for a plan on every eligible purchase in the HSBC UAE app.

A cash instalment plan lets you access cash up to your credit limit. You can apply online or by phone for competitive rates, with no need for proof of income.

You can also transfer balances from other credit cards in the UAE to your HSBC Credit Card and:

- save on interest

- enjoy competitive pricing

- get control of your finances by consolidating and repaying your balances more easily

You can apply in online banking, by calling us or by using the instructions we send you. We'll call you within 2 working days.

A Balance Transfer fee applies. Please refer to the Schedule of Services and Tariffs (PDF) for more details.

##
You might also be interested in

###

Rewards

Discover more about our best rewards on selected credit cards. Earn and exchange reward points for flights, hotels, shopping, events and more.

###

Live+ Credit Card

Get up to 6% cashback on daily spends and no annual fees for the first year.

###

Live+ cashback calculator

Find out how much you could earn from your Live+ Credit Card spending with our handy cashback calculator.

##

Additional information

We've described the benefits and features of this card on this page. However, we may change these at any time at our discretion. We'll try and let you know about any changes, either before the change or shortly afterwards.

Back to top

The Skyward Miles you earn with the card won't expire for as long as your Emirates Skywards account and credit card are open.[@nomilesexpiry]Footnote link 8Footnote link 8Footnote link 8

From paying bills to purchasing flights, you'll earn Miles every time you spend on your card.[@cards-skyward-miles-earning]

#### How to earn Skywards Miles explore-skywards-infinite-benefits

Flight bookings

Get 2.75 Skywards Miles on direct bookings with Emirates and flydubai in AED

-

Non AED-transactions

Get 1.5 Skywards Miles on non-AED transactions

-

AED transactions

Get 1 Skywards Miles on AED transactions

-

Other spends

Get 0.25 Skywards Miles on government services, public transport, utilities, telecoms, education, real estate, fuel, groceries and supermarkets, insurance and auto dealers (AED)

-

Skywards Living

Accelerate your Skywards Miles earning with Skywards Living. Pay with your HSBC Emirates Skywards Credit Card with Emirates Skywards partners and multiply your Miles earning.

###
Enjoy more of the things you love

A range of rewards on shopping, travel, eating out and more, worldwide.

Get up to 50% off dining bills at over 4,000 restaurants across the UAE with your complimentary Zomato Gold membership. Learn more.

Get 3 complimentary visits a month to premium beach clubs across the UAE. T&Cs apply.
